title: React stories are a smaller part of JavaScript stories than before
question: Are React stories a smaller part of JavaScript stories than before?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: React is losing ground inside the JavaScript conversation: for every JavaScript story, fewer stories name React now than before.
expect: If true, React stories per JavaScript story over the latest 12 months should be at most 0.85x the same ratio over all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (0.95x is weak, 1.1x or higher refutes it).
thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h304, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h304 is left unchanged.
caveats: A title that names React or JavaScript is not proof the story is about it, and one story can name both.
Both lists are title words only, so stories that never name the tool are missed.
The ratio shows React against JavaScript titles, not against every newer front-end tool; h375 covers that comparison on points.
